title: Health & pharmacy
body:
Emergency number 112 (free, 24/7) covers police, fire and ambulance. Tap water is safe to drink throughout Portugal. Pharmacies (farmácia) are marked with a green cross; most keep normal shop hours, with a rotating late-night pharmacy roster posted in every pharmacy window.

US travelers have no reciprocal public healthcare in Portugal — bring travel insurance that covers overseas medical care.
checklist: Save 112 in your phone before you land
Pack medicines in original packaging with a copy of any prescriptions
Confirm travel insurance covers overseas medical care

title: Tram 28 and crowded spots — the standard caution
body: Tram 28 and other packed tourist routes draw the pickpocket attention any crowded transit line does — keep bags zipped and in front of you, especially standing near the doors. A specific 'Tram 28 is notorious' claim circulates widely online, but the primary US government source for it (travel.state.gov) isn't independently confirmable against a live fetch — treat it as standard big-city caution rather than a confirmed official warning.
